scope: Add a framework-neutral receive-driven ASGI profile method around the existing AsgiCoreProfileAdapter, so a host can provide receive() and send() and the adapter collects http.request body chunks before dispatching through the existing call/handle.

change.added: AsgiCoreProfileAdapter#callFromReceive({ scope, receive, send, decodeBody }) in src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs
behavior: validates receive and send are functions, and decodeBody is a function when provided, before any router call
validates scope the same way handle/call do; an invalid scope short-circuits to the existing frozen 400 profile events without ever calling receive
awaits receive() repeatedly, collecting http.request event body chunks in order until more_body is not true
a malformed receive event (not an ordinary object, wrong type, or a non-Uint8Array body chunk) short-circuits deterministically to the existing frozen 400 profile events without calling the router
a rejecting receive() propagates its rejection

concatenates collected chunks into a single Uint8Array; when decodeBody is provided, passes the merged bytes through it and uses its return value as body, short-circuiting to the 400 profile events on a thrown decode error; otherwise uses the merged bytes directly as body
dispatches the resolved scope/body through the existing call method unchanged, so send/event/error behavior of call is reused verbatim
no server/framework/network import; no Python ASGI app

targeted: rejects non-function receive/send without invoking receive or the router
rejects a non-function decodeBody without invoking the router
collects a multi-chunk http.request body in order before dispatching
short-circuits to a 400 profile response on a malformed receive event (bad type, non-Uint8Array body) without calling the router
short-circuits to a 400 profile response on an invalid scope without ever calling receive
decodeBody success path applies it to the merged bytes; decodeBody throwing short-circuits to the 400 profile response
